component.name: Accordion Player
component.summary: Free player for button and piano accordion with fingering

description.p: Accordion Player shows you exactly what to press. Open a piece and watch both hands on the instrument: the right-hand buttons or piano keys, the left-hand basses and chords, and the finger number for every note. At the same time you hear the piece as it should sound.
The player is free. It needs no account and has no limits: playback, all instruments, practice tools, full screen and video recording are free forever.

ul.li: See the right and left hand on a button accordion (B-griff and other layouts) or a piano accordion
Follow the finger numbers, note names or chord types on every button
Read the notes on the staff or watch falling notes in lanes
Change the tempo, loop a passage, use the metronome and a count-in, mute a hand
Enlarge any part of the instrument to see small buttons clearly
Record a Full HD video of your practice with sound
Use the interface in English or Ukrainian

description.p: Accordion Player opens .accplay files. Make them yourself in Accordion Editor, or open the demo pieces that come with the app. Your files and settings stay on your device.
